column3: Preserves the image of lifting his feet.
Preserves “son of Nahor” rather than specifying “grandson”.
Preserves the repeated description “Laban, his mother’s brother”.
Preserves the kinship term “brother” rather than “a relative”.
Preserves “bone and flesh” rather than “flesh and blood”.
Preserves “tender” for the eyes rather than “weak”.
Preserves “my days are fulfilled” and “go in to her” rather than “my time” and “sleep with her”.
